selected_architecture.summary: At a one-slot origin-drop recovery boundary, choose the frozen radius-1 local rescue candidate whenever at least one eligible local candidate exists; invoke the unchanged global surviving-intent allocation arm only when the local eligible set is empty.

scientific_question: Can the complementary local and allocation capabilities observed across the complete 36-case development trace be realized by an executable teacher-blind one-slot failover policy, while preserving all local exact recoveries, capturing the allocation-only recovery, and avoiding global allocation search on cases where local rescue is available?

established: Corrected all-nine run 40151063835 returned COMPLEMENTARY_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY with all 9 papers/36 stresses valid.
The local arm has 3 exact recoveries, all local-only; the allocation arm has 1 exact recovery, allocation-only; both_exact=0 and neither=32.
The sole allocation-only exact recovery is SHALLOW_FRONTIER; depth-extension exact recoveries=0.
Local eligible candidate exists in 31/36 stresses; the five local-empty stresses include the one allocation-only exact recovery.
Trace-derived lazy local-first cost is 272 candidate rows / 46,569 raw candidate chars with allocation invoked on 5/36 stresses, versus 923 / 161,192 for allocation on all stresses.
Independent post-result review accepts complementarity but forbids oracle union, removed-proposition-aware arbitration, teacher-informed arbitration, and acceptance freeze.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The complementary arm capability is realizable without oracle arbitration because the allocation-only exact recovery occurs in a case with no eligible local candidate.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: The exact local-first/fallback operator preserves all 3 local exact recoveries and captures the 1 allocation-only recovery for hybrid_exact_recovery_count=4.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The fallback condition does not actually expose the allocation-only capability under executable replay.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: All 3 local exact recoveries are preserved but the allocation-only exact recovery is missed, yielding hybrid_exact_recovery_count=3.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Serializing the two arms changes or corrupts local recovery behavior despite the frozen trace inputs.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: At least one of the three known local exact recoveries is no longer selected by the hybrid.

mechanism_family_comparison.rationale: It is the smallest executable policy that preserves the cheaper/more-effective local arm and invokes allocation only in the exact structural condition that exposes its unique known capability: no eligible local candidate. It adds no learned score, threshold, query, model, or extra evidence slot.

Allocation produces a candidate in all 36 frozen stresses, so local fallback would never execute; the policy collapses to the allocation-only arm with only one exact recovery and much higher candidate-search cost.

Requires a new cross-arm comparability/ranking rule not yet justified by evidence and risks introducing a fresh scoring problem when simple structural failover can realize the observed complementarity.
Would change the fixed one-slot budget28 recovery contract to budget29 and confound mechanism realization with additional evidence capacity.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Verify that the exact teacher-blind local-first/fallback policy is an executable realization of the observed complementary arm capabilities and quantify its lazy search cost before any end-to-end selector integration.

frozen_inputs.teacher_use: Removed proposition identity and exact-recovery flags are evaluation-only. They may not select the hybrid arm or candidate.

steps: For each exact source-report stress, verify the source local and allocation results are from the frozen reviewed arms.
If source local.chosen is not null, select exactly source local.chosen and mark selected_arm=LOCAL.
If source local.chosen is null, select exactly source allocation.chosen when non-null and mark selected_arm=ALLOCATION_FALLBACK; otherwise select nothing.
Append at most one proposition. The recovered evidence-set budget remains 28 when a candidate exists and 27 when neither arm supplies a candidate.
Do not inspect removed_proposition_id, exact-recovery booleans, historical evidence pages, teacher labels, or any semantic oracle until after selected_arm and selected proposition are fixed.
After action is fixed, score structural exact recovery against removed_proposition_id and aggregate costs.

controls: Frozen allocation-everywhere candidate cost=923 rows / 161,192 raw chars.
Oracle union upper bound of known top-choice capabilities=4/36 is evaluation context only and may not choose actions.

safety: removed proposition and exact flags excluded from selection
no teacher/historical-page data used for selection

HYBRID_COMPLEMENTARITY_REALIZED: All three source local exact recoveries remain exact under LOCAL selection.
The source allocation-only exact recovery is selected under ALLOCATION_FALLBACK.

Interpretation: the complementary structural capabilities are realizable by a simple teacher-blind failover policy; authorize end-to-end development integration and semantic/provenance/fallback validation, not acceptance promotion.
HYBRID_COLLAPSES_TO_LOCAL: All three source local exact recoveries are preserved but the source allocation-only exact recovery is not captured.
Interpretation: failover does not realize the observed complementarity; reject this hybrid and revisit a non-oracle cross-arm arbitration design.
HYBRID_REGRESSION: At least one source local exact recovery is lost under the hybrid action.
Interpretation: serial failover is not behaviorally equivalent to the frozen local arm; reject the operator.
INVALID_EXECUTION: Any exact report identity, stress count, action-before-evaluation, one-slot budget, or no-teacher/no-oracle selection check fails.
Interpretation: no hybrid verdict; repair only unchanged replay mechanics with fresh explicit authority.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid realization execution after independent design review. No changes to source report, local-first condition, selected arm actions, one-slot budget, metrics, or verdicts after seeing the result.

pass_authority.HYBRID_COMPLEMENTARITY_REALIZED: Authorize end-to-end development integration of LOCAL_FIRST_ALLOCATION_FALLBACK_HYBRID_V1 into the selected evidence architecture, followed by legacy semantic/provenance/fallback/VERIFY/resource validation before any ACCEPTANCE_CANDIDATE_FROZEN declaration.
pass_authority.HYBRID_COLLAPSES_TO_LOCAL: Reject local-first failover as the hybrid realization and compare a new teacher-blind cross-arm arbitration family.
pass_authority.HYBRID_REGRESSION: Reject the hybrid operator; preserve component-arm evidence and diagnose implementation/interaction before further architecture selection.

reviewer_boundary: Independent reviewer must audit this exact hybrid realization design before implementation. A valid realization result requires post-result review before end-to-end integration design. The sealed acceptance benchmark remains off-limits.
next_safe_action: Run normal CI on this design-only artifact and merge only if clean. Then checkpoint exact design in workspace-control and obtain independent review before implementing LOCAL_FIRST_ALLOCATION_FALLBACK_REALIZATION_V1.
